summary_en: Interim dividend ¥24/share effective 2026-07-13, record date 2026-04-30; total payout ¥170M. First payment under new semi-annual dividend policy (shift from annual-only regime announced 2026-03-12). Full-year guidance: ¥65/share (¥24 interim + ¥41 year-end).
title_en: Notice regarding surplus dividend distribution (interim dividend and initial payment)
translation_en_brief: ASIRO Inc. announced on 2026-06-12 an interim dividend of ¥24.00 per share with a record date of 2026-04-30 and effective date of 2026-07-13, totalling ¥170 million from retained earnings. This is the first interim payment under a newly adopted semi-annual dividend policy. The company had announced a shift from annual-only to semi-annual dividends on 2026-03-12, with stated objectives of expanding stable shareholder returns and broadening the investor base. Full-year dividend guidance for fiscal 2026 is ¥65 per share (¥24 interim + ¥41 year-end), compared to ¥42.20 for the prior fiscal year 2025. The company stated it will continue to balance growth investment with shareholder returns and pursue mid- to long-term enhancement of enterprise value.
